section TheoryAxioms

/-- Axiom of Observer Solidification --/

  deltaPsi : Real  -- Accumulated phase difference ($\Delta\Psi$). Tracks rotational decoherence over time steps.
}

/-- Helper function to calculate the final scalar 'S' value after T1 evolution --/
def calculate_final_S(t1_new : Real): Real := by

section Constants

/-- A. Fundamental MathConstants --/
constant PI_VAL : Real := pi           -- Mathematical constant Pi. Required for all angular measurements.\nconstant E_VAL : Real := e        -- Euler's number e. Defines natural exponential growth laws.\nconstant PHI : Real := (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2  -- Golden Ratio, derived from local integer sequences/geometry.

/-- B. Derived FSOT Constants (from pflt_v2 analysis) --/
constant G_CAT : Real := 0.91596559417721901505460351493238411077414937428167 -- Global Coupling Constant (Assumed Axiomatic).
constant ALPHA : Real := ln(PI_VAL) / (E_VAL * PHI^13)  -- Alpha constant, derived from Pi/e/phi relationship.
constant PSI_CON : Real := 1 - exp(-1)       -- Psi-Constant. Defines the natural decay rate of information entropy.\nconstant ETA_EFF : Real := 1 / (PI_VAL - 1) -- Effective Time Constant based on PI deviation.$\nconstant BETA : Real := 1 / $\exp$($\text{PI\_VAL}^\text{PI\_VAL} + (\text{E\_VAL} - 1)$) -- Beta factor, derived from exponential scaling laws.
constant GAMMA_C : Real := -ln(2) / PHI       -- Gamma-Correction Factor. Relates to binary information loss.$
constant OMEGA : Real := sin(PI_VAL / E_VAL) * sqrt(2) -- Omega field amplitude. Measures oscillatory influence.$\nconstant THETA_S : Real := sin(PSI_CON * ETA_EFF)  -- Structural Phase Angle, a function of entropy and time constants.\nconstant POOF : Real := $\exp(($-\ln(\text{PI\_VAL}) / E\_VAL) / (\text{ETA\_EFF} * \ln(\text{PHI})))$ -- Poof Factor: Measures non-linear coupling strength.

/-- C. Highly Derived FSOT Parameters (The full system state vector components) --/
constant C_PRIME : Real := $(\text{POOF} \cdot (1 - \sin(\text{THETA\_S}) / \text{PHI})) * (\text{PHI} / \sqrt2)$ -- The primary mathematical coefficient relating coherence to structural phase.
constant K : Real := PHI * (\text{GAMMA} / E_VAL) * sqrt(2) / ln(PI_VAL) * 0.99 -- Global Scaling Constant K, including the final system normalization factor.

end Concepts
